semiconductor_relevance: High — SemiGlory Electronics specializes in transfer and handling products essential for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: SemiGlory Electronics (Chongqing) Co., Ltd is a full-service designer and manufacturer of transfer and handling products used in the ultra-clean chemical manufacturing process of semiconductor devices. With over 20 years of experience, they focus on semiconductor packaging and engineering plastics, providing solutions that enhance wafer protection and automation interfaces.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Chongqing, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
